waypoints.name: Hwy 20 pullout near MP 166 (descent finish)
waypoints.note: This roadside pullout is where the descent over Burgundy Col comes back to the highway, not where the East Ridge starts. The climb begins at the Cedar Creek Trailhead near Mazama, several highway miles east, so leave a car here or plan the road walk back.
waypoints.directions: On SR-20, park at the broad roadside pullout near milepost 166, about 4 miles east of Washington Pass on the Mazama side. This is where the descent over Burgundy Col comes back to the highway, so leave a shuttle car here; the East Ridge itself starts from the Cedar Creek Trailhead near Mazama.
